backend_selection: Exactly sixteen results including failures. A backend qualifies only if all eight of its architecture/width cases pass. Minimize the sum of within-case median block times; CPU wins an exact tie. Query timings are reported but do not change this fixed selector. No retries or tolerance revisions under this protocol.
dimension_scope: Upper bounds including the asset indicator. Original active-column removal can reduce actual dimensions.

orchestration_smoke_check.initial_manual_assertion_failure: A float32 reduction of valid float32 weights differed from 1017 by 0.00012207, just outside a hand-written 1e-7 relative smoke assertion. Using float64 accumulation gave 1017.0000106096268 and 1017.000002682209. No production code or frozen numerical/backend tolerance changed.
orchestration_smoke_check.scope: Completeness, duplicate/nonfinite rejection, failed-case exclusion, no feasible backend, CPU tie preference, synthetic shapes/weights and 7070-query clock/probability sanity.

projection: 6*169*median_block_seconds + 12*median_query_seconds, reported only as an operational extrapolation excluding full-grid allocation, normalization, preparation, paging, checkpointing, assessment and replay.
purpose: Prospective exact operational definition for the already registered temporal-attention family; full-size runtime execution remains conditional on completion of the three earlier studies and the fresh-confirmation priority.
query_positions: 127, 131, ..., 635; 128 stride-four positions across each of eight streams.
resource_scope: Sampled process RSS plus sampled MPS driver bytes can double-count unified allocations and miss instantaneous peaks. Full historical grid allocation, paging and market preparation are absent from this block benchmark.
synthetic_weights: Compute N/(6*n_asset_class) once across the complete synthetic supervised block and freeze them for all updates; these are synthetic counts, not market four-day frequencies. No per-update rebalancing.
timing_probe: Continue the independently warmed model and its optimizer through eight timed updates. Time three complete 7070-query posterior evaluations at the fixed checked weights. Synchronize MPS before/after timing; do not fit a market model.
warmup_probe: Start with the registered zero correction and complete three nonzero optimizer updates independently on each backend. CPU post-warmup parameters are then copied exactly for a separate fixed-weight probability and gradient arithmetic comparison. Report independent-training forecast agreement separately.
